download_seeker_lm_med_model: download the SeeKeR LM Medium GPT2 model fine-tuned on SeeKeR data to a given datapath
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch the seeker_lm_med model version v1.0 into the specified directory
summarize_download_function: summarize the download function that calls download_with_model_type with seeker_lm_med and version v1.0
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how it delegates to download_with_model_type for model retrieval
test_download_function: test the download function by passing a datapath and verifying the seeker_lm_med model is downloaded
